title: EVANGELION: DEATH — ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK
subtitle: incl. EVANGELION: REBIRTH | King Records KICA-360 | 1997
appeal_heading: The Soundtrack to the Death & Rebirth Film
appeal_body: The soundtrack for Neon Genesis Evangelion: Death & Rebirth (1997). Music by Shiro Sagisu, BGM structure by director Hideaki Anno himself — 16 tracks including the unforgettable classical-music recompositions that define the "DEATH" half: Bach's Suite for Cello solo, Vivaldi's Partita, and four versions of Pachelbel's Kanon in D woven through the EVA pilots' inner worlds, plus the "REBIRTH" bonus tracks closing on "Dies irae (REQUIEM)". The pale-blue sky cover with the mirrored EVANGELION logo is one of the most beautiful in the franchise. A cornerstone of any Eva music collection.
